messages:
elena: Dropping this live thread for follow-ups from today's all-hands. Use this for strategy questions, positioning clarifications, market signals, and competitor calls. I'll check in through the afternoon. (Slides + recording linked below)

marta: Quick one for enablement: customers in APAC ask if our Dedicated offering supports local regions and partner managed infra. What's the short answer?
das: Also from product: should we start mentioning kernel-level optimizations (fused attention, nvprims) in public docs or keep that for engineering audiences?
ryan: GTM: reps want a single sentence to differentiate us vs MegaCloud AI on procurement objections (procurement always asks "why not just use our cloud's managed endpoints").
alisa: engineering ask: any change to recommended defaults for 8k+ contexts? i.e., advise smaller batch sizes, enable prefix caching by default?
elena: Short answers: APAC Dedicated can be offered via partner-managed pools in select regions; we're expanding partner SLAs this year. We'll publish a short partner matrix.
elena: Kernel optimizations: highlight them in an "under the hood" developer doc. For customer-facing pages, translate into benefits (lower p95, cost savings) rather than technical names.
elena: Procurement line: "Redwood gives you deployment parity and SLA-backed performance across hosted, dedicated, and private, so you avoid vendor lock-in while meeting security and cost targets."
elena: Long-context defaults: recommend enabling prefix/KV caching + dynamic batching; only use aggressive quantization after regen-quality checks. We'll update the runtime defaults doc.

marta: for enablement: can we get a one-paragraph blurb on partner-managed Dedicated for APAC? reps need it asap.
ryan: also, any public-facing numbers for "unit economics" we can quote? reps keep getting asked for $$/1M tokens for Dedicated vs hosted.
elena: We'll publish ballpark unit economics ranges in next week's GTM one-pager. Internally we'll keep more granular tables.
das: about kernel names: engineering customers sometimes search for keywords like "fused attention"; could we add those as hidden SEO phrases linking to the benefits page?
elena: Good idea  add engineering keywords to SEO metadata but keep the public content benefit-focused. Ops, pls follow up on SEO tasks.
ops-bot: Slides + recording uploaded: https://redwood/ah/1877770000 (auto)
alisa: perf ask: could you confirm a short perf snippet we can point prospects to? even a simple p95 range per model class helps.
elena: Sure, rough verified snapshot for the catalog (anonymized):
```
Model class: 13B-ish dense
Typical HW: 2x T4 equiv
p50 ~ 40-80ms, p95 ~ 90-220ms depending on seq length and caching
```

ryan: great, i'll bake that into the sales script. any guidance on calling out hyperscaler price competitiveness?
elena: Lead with value: predictable SLOs, private deployment options, and rollout controls. Use published ranges when pressed, but avoid headline-to-headline price wars; those are deal-level conversations.
marta: i'll prep the APAC partner blurb and sync with partnerships. thanks.
das: will add the kernel keywords to the draft docs.
elena: I'll post the APAC partner matrix + GTM one-pager by EOD. Thanks all for the questions. :raised_hands:
